arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُحْيي مَعالِمِ الدّينِ وَ اَهْلِهِ
transliteration: ʾayna muḥyiyy maʿālimi al-dīn wa ahlih?
english_text: Where is he who shall blot out dogma in the matter of religion and his (Muhammad’s) children?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ قاصِمُ شَوْكَةِ الْمُعْتَدينَ
transliteration: ʾayna qāṣimu shawkati l-muʿtadīn
english_text: Where is he who shall break up meddlesome trouble and tampering?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ هادِمُ اَبْنِيَةِ الشِّرْكِ وَ النِّفاقِ
transliteration: ʾayna hādimu abniyati al-shirk wa al-nifāq?
english_text: Where is he who shall pull down the foundations of confusion (polytheists) and hypocrisy?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُبيدُ اَهْلِ الْفُسُوقِ وَ الْعِصْيانِ وَ الطُّغْيانِ
transliteration: ʾayna mubīdu ahl al-fusūq wa al-ʿiṣyān wa al-ṭughyān?
english_text: Where is he who shall stamp out corruption, vice, reaction and injustice?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ حاصِدُ فُرُوعِ الْغَيِّ وَ الشِّقاقِ ( النِفاقِ )
transliteration: ʾayna ḥāṣidu furūʿi al-ghayyi wa al-shiqāqi (al-nifāqi)
english_text: Where is he who shall trim the outgrowth of despair, longing and hardships?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ طامِسُ آثارِ الزَّيْغِ وَ الاَْهْواء
transliteration: ʾayna ṭāmisu āthāri al-zayghi wal-ahwā'i
english_text: Where is he who shall erase the traces of unfairness and self-seeking conceit?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ قاطِعُ حَبائِلِ الْكِذْبِ ( الكَذِبِ ) وَ الاِْفْتِراءِ
transliteration: ʾayna qaṭiʿu ḥabāʾili al-kidhbi (al-kadhibi) wal-iftirāʾi
english_text: Where is he who shall untie the twisted knotes of falsehood and disruption?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُبيدُ الْعُتاةِ وَ الْمَرَدَةِ
transliteration: ʾayna mubīdu al-ʿutāti wa al-maradati
english_text: Where is he who shall separate senselessness and insolence from the people?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُسْتَأصِلُ اَهْلِ الْعِنادِ وَ التَّضْليلِ وَ الاِْلْحادِ
transliteration: ʾayna mustaṣʾilu ahlil-ʿinād wa ttaḍlīli wa al-ilhād
english_text: Where is he who shall tear up by the roots obstinacy, corruption and apostasy?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُـعِزُّ الاَْوْلِياءِ وَ مُذِلُّ الاَْعْداءِ
transliteration: ʾayna muʿizzu al-awliyāʾi wa mudhillu al-aʿdāʾi
english_text: Where is he who shall love dearly the favourites of Allah and take pains to tame and train the trangressors?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ جامِعُ الْكَلِمَةِ ( الكَلِمِ ) عَلَى التَّقْوى
transliteration: ʾayna jāmiʿu al-kalimah (al-kalimi) ʿalā al-taqwá
english_text: Where is he who shall make people familiar with "words of wisdom"?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ بابُ اللهِ الَّذى مِنْهُ يُؤْتى
transliteration: ʾayna bābu l-lāhi alladhī minhu yuʾtā
english_text: Where is the ultimate (Divine) source of plenty and prosperity?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ وَجْهُ اللهِ الَّذى اِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ الاَْوْلِياءُ
transliteration: ʾayna wajhu l-lāhi a-lladhi ilayhi yatawajjahu l-awliyā'u
english_text: Where is the "Divine aspect" the God-fearing may look up to? Where is the link that connects the cosmic complex?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ السَّبَبُ الْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ الاَْرْضِ وَ السَّماءِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-sababu al-muttasilu bayna al-arḍi wa al-samāʾi
english_text: Where is the authority who shall communicate and make known the true point of view?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ صاحِبُ يَوْمِ الْفَتْحِ وَ ناشِرُ رايَةِ الْهُدى
transliteration: ʾayna ṣāḥibu yawm al-fatḥi wa nāshiru rāyat al-hudá
english_text: Where is the author of the conception of peace, fairplay and welfare?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ مُؤَلِّفُ شَمْلِ الصَّلاحِ وَ الرِّضا
transliteration: ʾayna muʾallifu shamli al-ṣalāḥi wa al-riḍā
english_text: Where is the author of the conception of peace, fairplay and welfare?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الطّالِبُ بِذُحُولِ الاَْنْبِياءِ وَ اَبْناءِ الاَْنْبِياءِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-ṭālibu biḏuḥūli al-anbiyāʾi wa ʾibnāʾi al-anbiyāʾi
english_text: Where is the defender of the traditions of the Prophets and their children?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الطّالِبُ ( المُطالِبُ ) بِدَمِ الْمَقْتُولِ بِكَرْبَلاءَ
transliteration: ʾayna al-ṭālibu (al-muṭālibu) bi-dami al-maqtūli bi-karbala.
english_text: Where is the investigator of the blood of the Martyrs of Karbalaa?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمَنْصُورُ عَلى مَنِ اعْتَدى عَلَيْهِ وَ افْتَرى
transliteration: ʾayna al-mansūru ʿalá mani iʿtadá ʿalayhi wa-iftarā
english_text: Where is he who shall get the upper hand over the perpetrators of crime and greed?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُضْطَرُّ الَّذي يُجابُ اِذا دَعا
transliteration: ʾayna al-mudhṭarru alladhī yujābu idhā daʿā?
english_text: Where is he who shall not rest until he answers the cries of help when called upon?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ صَدْرُ الْخَلائِقِ ذُوالْبِرِّ وَ التَّقْوى
transliteration: ʾayna ṣadr al-khalāʾiqi dhū al-birri wa al-taqwá
english_text: Where is the foremost leader of the people – the just, the truthful and the wise?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ ابْنُ النَّبِىِّ الْمُصْطَفى ، وَ ابْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْمُرْتَضى
transliteration: ʾayna ibnu al-nabiyyi al-musṭafá wa ibnu ʿaliyyin al-murtaḍá
english_text: Where is the son of the chosen Prophet? The son of Ali Al-Murtaza!

arabic_text: وَ ابْنُ خَديجَةَ الْغَرّآءِ ، وَ ابْنُ فاطِمَةَ الْكُبْرى
transliteration: wa ibn khadijata al-gharrai, wa ibn fatimata al-kubra
english_text: The son of Khadeejah, the resplendent! The son of Faatimah, the great!

arabic_text: بِاَبي اَنْتَ وَ اُمّي وَ نَفْسي لَكَ الْوِقاءُ وَ الْحِمى
transliteration: bi-abi anta wa ummi wa nafsi laka al-wiqāʾu wa al-ḥimā
english_text: My father, my mother, and I turn to you for protection and sanctuary.

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ السّادَةِ الْمُقَرَّبينَ
transliteration: yā ibna al-sādah al-muqarrabīn
english_text: O son of the favourite Leaders!

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ النُّجَباءِ الاَْكْرَمينَ
transliteration: yā ibn al-nujabāʾ al-akramīn
english_text: O Son of the distinguished nobles!

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ الْهُداةِ الْمَهْدِيّينَ ( المُهْتَدينَ )
transliteration: yā bna al-hudāh al-mahdiyyīn (al-muhtadīn)
english_text: O son of the rightly guided Guides!

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ الْخِيَرَةِ الْمُهَذَّبينَ
transliteration: yā ibnal-khiyarah al-muhaḏḏabīn
english_text: O Son of the most refined high-minded liberals!

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ الْغَطارِفَةِ الاَْنْجَبينَ
transliteration: yā ibnal-ghaṭārifati al-anjabīn
english_text: O Son of the select generous Guardians!

arabic_text: يَا بْنَ الاَْطائِبِ الْمُطَهَّرينَ ( المُتَطَهْريِِنَ )
transliteration: yā ibna al-aṭā'ib al-muṭahharīn (al-mutaṭahhirīn)
english_text: O son of the polite and pure purifiers!
